description: Stateless home-mls-ds relay (3A) exchanging an active registered device's single-use PDS delegation token with a remote Space authority or remote Space host without exposing the client's IP address to third-party servers.

authorityDid.description: DID of the Space authority serving com.atproto.space.authorizeSpaceSync; it must be the authority named in space.

space.description: Exactly at:space/{authorityDid}/{spaceType}/{skey}. Other schemes, including at-space:// and the alpha form at://{authorityDid}/space/..., and Space record URIs are rejected. The returned credential's sub equals this string.

delegationToken.description: Single-use delegation JWT minted by the user's PDS (com.atproto.space.getDelegationToken): sub is exactly space, aud is {authorityDid}#atproto_pds, it carries no cnf claim, and it lives at most 60 seconds. The home forwards it to the authority in a POST body without reading it.

cnfKey.description: Client ephemeral P-256 did:key for RFC 9421 proof-of-possession. The authority binds the credential's cnf.kid to it, and the home rejects a credential bound to any other key.

clientAttestation.description: Optional OAuth client attestation JWT forwarded to com.atproto.space.authorizeSpaceSync.

spaceRev.description: Optional known Space revision forwarded to com.atproto.space.authorizeSpaceSync.

errors.name: AccountTakedown
errors.description: The operator has taken this account down. Only deleting the account's own data is still allowed.
